plan.notes: Source: Northeast Community College official program sheet 'Early Childhood Education AA' (https://northeast.edu/_documents/programs/early-childhood-aa.pdf), 'Suggested Pathway of Study for Associate of Arts Degree (2 years)' (transfer pathway). Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog gives ranges (Fine Arts and Language 3-4, Natural Science 4-5, SOCI 2150 1-3, Electives 7-8) and a total of 60-65 credits; this seed resolves ranges to their minimums (Fine Arts 3, Natural Science 4, EDUC 1100 3, Electives 7), yielding 62 credits, inside the catalog range. Generic gen-ed categories are modeled as ELECTIVE-n choice slots. Recommended electives per catalog: ECED 1060, ECED 1110, ECED 1120, ECED 1160, ECED 1220, ECED 1260, ECED 1610, ECED 1620, ECED 1630, ECED 2450, EDUC 2000, EDUC 2250, MATH 1015 — see advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed on the program sheet; see https://northeast.edu/catalog. '*' marks gen-ed courses. Child care providers require a criminal background check prior to employment.
